symptom: combo box `CaptionAttribute: FullName` on an entity extending Administration.Account fails mxbuild with CE1613 (`BIA.Employee.FullName` no longer exists); `Administration.Account.FullName` works. check and lint pass
cause: the widget engine's CaptionAttribute mapping qualified the name by concatenating the context entity, while every other attribute mapping goes through `resolveAttributePathForEntity`, which finds the declaring entity (the #12 inheritance fix missed this case)
insight: Grep for `entity + "." +` when a CE1613 on an inherited attribute is reported: each hand-qualified path is a separate instance of the same defect
